summary: Improve hotel website visibility, local SEO, and direct-booking measurement with practical five-day training. Explore the course and enrol.
lede: Hospitality SEO improves how hotel and hospitality pages are discovered and presented in search. For hotel marketing managers, digital specialists, and revenue managers, the training addresses organic visibility and the path from search landing pages to direct bookings. You practise mapping keywords to pages, auditing crawlability and mobile performance, and improving local search and structured data while measuring booking-funnel activity.
audienceIntro: SEO for hospitality websites training suits professionals who manage hotel discovery, website performance, content, bookings, and digital demand generation. You can apply the methods in independent properties, hotel groups, resorts, serviced accommodation, travel experiences, and hospitality technology environments.
modules: Hotel Keyword Research with Search Console
Technical SEO and Core Web Vitals
Hotel SEO Roadmap and Stakeholder Buy-In
prerequisites: You should have working knowledge of digital marketing, hotel or hospitality website content, and basic analytics concepts. Experience with Google Search Console or GA4 is useful but not mandatory. No coding or programming is required. Exercises use guided templates and provided examples, while technical concepts remain at operational application level rather than engineering implementation level.
